methodology: dist builds (fat LTO) of the baseline and the changed grit-cli. Isolated config environment (GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, near-empty GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL). Five warmups, then 400 interleaved rounds of system Git, baseline grit and changed grit with rotating order; mutating rows reset with git, untimed, before each sample. Wall time is the median of spawn-to-wait4 in Python. Peak RSS is the median of 21 /usr/bin/time -f %M runs per tool. No builds or tests ran during measurement.

profile.tool: valgrind callgrind; heaptrack; perf stat page-faults (no hardware counters in the VM)
